question_text: Compare a single central networked controller with distributed room controllers for climate control across a large campus.
adaptation_rationale: Retains architecture/fault-tolerance reasoning under required distributed digital infrastructure; does not invent separate mandatory control-system categories.
solution: Central design makes one controller responsible for decisions; distributed design shares work among room controllers.; A central controller can simplify administration but becomes a single failure point.; Distributed controllers can keep local rooms operating if one controller fails.; Distributed operation adds coordination/consistency/management complexity, while central failure can affect all rooms.
